info.title: Transit Accessibility Heatmap public API
info.description:
Public API behind the gateway. GENERATED by `pnpm contracts:gen` from the service contracts in
`contracts/openapi/`; do not edit by hand.

Every operation keeps `x-access` (public, user, admin), `x-rate-limit` (requests per minute,
per user id when signed in, otherwise per client IP) and `x-service` (upstream). The gateway
sets `X-User-Id` and `X-User-Role` for the upstream after verifying the access token and
strips any such header sent by a client. Every response carries `X-Correlation-Id`.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description:
Request correlation id. The gateway creates one (UUID) when the client sends none and
forwards it; every service logs it, returns it and passes it on.

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token for a new pair (rotation)
post.description:
The presented token is revoked and replaced. Presenting a token that was already
replaced is treated as theft: every session of the user is revoked and `401` is returned.

post.summary: Change the password and end every other session
post.description:
The refresh-token cookie is scoped to `/api/v1/auth`, so this request cannot tell which
session is the current one. Every refresh token of the user is revoked and a new pair is
issued in the response: the user stays signed in on this device only.

newPassword.description: Plain password in the request only; hashed with Argon2id, never stored or logged.

200.description: Password changed; all previous sessions ended, a new one started.
